info.title: Microsoft Teams Universal API
info.description: Access Microsoft Teams collaboration data and actions through Microsoft Graph, including teams, channels, chats, messages, tabs, files folders, and installed apps. This app uses delegated Microsoft Entra OAuth2 for work or school accounts.

post.description: Creates a new channel in Microsoft Teams.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

membershipType.description: Channel membership type. Use standard, private, or shared.

createdDateTime.description: Read-only timestamp at which the channel was created.

description.description: Optional textual description for the channel.

displayName.description: Channel name as it appears in Microsoft Teams.

email.description: Read-only email address for sending messages to the channel.

id.description: Read-only unique identifier for the channel.

isFavoriteByDefault.description: Whether the channel is recommended by default.

webUrl.description: Opaque Microsoft Teams client URL for the channel.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

post.description: Creates a new chat in Microsoft Teams.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

chatType.description: Chat type, for example oneOnOne or group.

members[].description: Array of conversation member objects. Include every participant, including the initiating user. Each item should include @odata.type, roles, and user@odata.bind per Microsoft Graph create chat docs.

createdDateTime.description: Timestamp at which the chat was created.

id.description: Unique identifier for the chat.

lastUpdatedDateTime.description: Timestamp at which the chat was last updated.

onlineMeetingInfo.description: Meeting information associated with the chat, when present.

webUrl.description: URL for the chat in Microsoft Teams.
